, after hearing the arguments, charges were framed for offence under Sections 406, 420 and 506(i) IPC.
Trial was ordered.
List witnesses cited by the Investigation Officer were examined as PW-1 to PW-10.

After examination of PW-1 to PW-10,
the Accused had filed a Petition under Section 311 Cr.P.C., to recall PW-1 to PW-3 and PW-6 to PW-10 and it was allowed on 18.08.2023.
Now, summons had been sent to PW-1 to PW-3 and PW-6 to PW-10.
The case is now adjourned to 22.03.2024.

4.Considering the remarks offered by the learned Judicial Magistrate, Theni, the learned Judicial Magistrate, Theni, is directed to dispose of the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis case within a reasonable period of one month. The learned Judicial Magistrate, Theni, shall follow the ratio laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Vinod Kumar vs State of Punjab reported in (2015) 3 SCC 220.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: When witnesses are are available before the Court, the witnesses shall be cross examined then and there.
Here, instead of cross examine the witnesses, the learned Counsel for the Accused had filed a Petition under Section 311 of Cr.P.C., seeking recall of the witnesses.
Therefore, the recall of the witnesses shall be done on the same day and when witnesses are appeared, the witnesses shall be cross examined.
The dilatory tactics adopted by the learned Counsels appearing for the accused shall not be encouraged or tolerated by the learned Judicial Magistrate.
The learned Judicial Magistrate is directed to act as assertive Judge, as a trial Judge, and dispose of the case on a time bound manner within a specified time.
The learned Judicial Magistrate is directed to conclude the examination of witnesses within a period of month from the date of appearance of PW-1 to PW-3 and PW-6 to PW-10.

Further, when the witnesses are examined, the learned Judicial Magistrate shall insist upon the learned Counsel for the Accused to cross examine the witnesses then and there and complete the entire recording of deposition within a reasonable period of one month and https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis dispose of the case within a further time of one month.

In the result, the Criminal Original Petition is disposed of.
